selfCare: Make space for how you feel
quickNotice: Tapping saves with the current time. Amounts and durations are left unknown. You can undo for 8 seconds.

saveStatus.unsaved: Could not confirm the save. Check your records or resend the same content.
saveStatus.undoFailed: Could not confirm the undo. Check your records.

pendingWriteNotice: This save has not been confirmed. A retry uses the original content and time.
abandonWrite: The first save may already have succeeded. Stop retrying? Check your records before adding a new one.
detailedRecord: Choose time, add details or use another type
recordedCountsOnly: These are saved entry counts. They may not include every event that happened.
exampleNotice: This is a demonstration. It does not save a household record or send anything to AI.
followUpNotice: The preview includes up to 2,000 characters of the question and 4,000 of the answer. Only the displayed text is attached when you select the option below. The earlier answer is also AI-generated text.
previousExchange: Review the previous question and answer
confirmPrevious: Attach this displayed question and answer
actualSubmission: Review this question and previous exchange
previousIncluded: The previous exchange shown above will be attached. Profile attachments are a separate choice.
previousExcluded: No previous exchange will be attached. Profile attachments are a separate choice.
draftPrivacy: Off by default. Enabling saves record input and retries, your question and selected previous exchange, and your current consultation sheet to your own account, beyond this device. Only input confirmed as saved can be recovered. Drafts stop being recoverable after 7 days and are deleted when accessed. Disabling removes saved drafts. Signing out clears screen memory.
enableRecovery: Save drafts to my account for optional recovery
draftRestoreNotice: Restoring replaces your current input in this area. The text or records may be old. Review before use. Recovery never sends to AI or saves a care record automatically.
deleteChatDraftConfirm: Delete the question draft and selected previous exchange? Earlier answers visible on this screen are kept.

draftStatus.unsaved: Current changes are not yet saved as a draft. Previously saved content may still be recoverable.
draftStatus.saved: Draft saved to your own account.
draftStatus.error: Could not save, check or delete the draft. Check your connection and review the latest state.
draftStatus.conflict: Another screen changed the draft or preference. Overwriting is paused. Review the latest draft.

recoveryOff: Draft recovery after reopening is off. You can choose it in Settings → Data and privacy.
preferenceFailed: Could not save the preference. Review the latest state and try again.
prepareCall: Prepare what to say on the phone
replaceCallScript: Switch to a script for another contact? This replaces the text you are editing.
callScriptTemplate:
Hello, I would like to speak with {{name}}.
I live in [your area]. My baby is [age, if relevant].
I would like help with [your question].
Could you explain eligibility, opening hours, booking and costs?
callScriptNotice: Replace the bracketed examples with the details you want to share. The app does not send this text to the contact.
prepareSheetFromCall: Use this in a consultation-sheet question
noPurposeContacts: No local contact is listed for this purpose yet. Check the public contact or national information above.
addCallQuestion: Add a question from your phone script (250 characters)
questionSlot: Question to use on the sheet
replaceQuestionNotice: This replaces the selected question. Up to 250 characters of a longer phone script are shown. Review and edit before adding it.
useCallQuestion: Use this text in the selected question
deleteSheetConfirm: Delete the current consultation sheet and reference drafts? Saved care records are kept.
maintenanceNotice: Review missing information, the checked date, the next review date and the public maintainer label. Select a contact to edit it.
localDraftUnsaved: These screen changes have not been saved as a draft yet.
serverDraftOnly: Draft saved. Families see changes only after you preview and publish them.
completePublication: Before publishing, check the institution name and every contact's name and valid HTTPS source URL. Also check field formats.
institutionConflict: Another editor changed the draft. Your input is kept. Copy any text you need before reloading the saved draft.
reloadDraftConfirm: Discard unsaved screen changes and reload the saved draft?
removeContactConfirm: Remove this contact from the draft? Families' published information stays until you publish.
restorePublicationNotice: Restore an earlier publication into the draft. Current public information stays until you review, preview and publish.
restoreVersionConfirm: Restore this publication into the draft? This replaces the current draft and leaves public information as it is.
restoreAsDraft: Restore this version as a draft
familySharingNotice: Each person joins with a separate account. Joining does not share your own records automatically. Family members see only categories explicitly selected by each owner from the last 7 days. Directory-editing permissions grant no household access.
yourInviteId: Your account ID to share with family
inviteIdNotice: Exchange IDs directly through a private channel. You do not need to share passwords. Invitation emails are not sent automatically.
invitationNotice: Choose what to share after joining. Baby records, parent records and notes are all off by default.
mySharing: My records visible to this family

sharingScopes.share_baby: Share baby feeding, diapers, sleep and pumping
sharingScopes.share_parent: Share my mood and recovery records
sharingScopes.share_notes: Also share free-text notes in the selected categories

sharingScopeNotice: These choices apply only to this family. Free-text notes stay hidden unless selected. Stopping sharing cannot recall copies others saved. Family sharing does not grant permission to send records to AI.
sharingNotSaved: Your sharing choices have not been saved.
sharingConflict: Membership or sharing changed on another screen. Saving these older choices is paused. Reload the latest settings before choosing what to share again.
reloadSharingConfirm: Discard unsaved sharing choices and reload the latest membership and sharing settings?
discardSharingChanges: Discard unsaved sharing changes and switch to another family?
inviteeId: Account ID of the person to invite
revokeConfirm: Revoke this membership or invitation? This stops future access to this family's records. Downloaded copies cannot be recalled.
leaveFamilyConfirm: Leave this family? Your own saved records are kept.
sharedRecentRecords: Shared records from the last 7 days
familyRecordedByNotice: Each person records through their own account. If two people record the same event, both entries are shown.
noSharedRecords: No selected shared records yet. Records appear after their owner saves sharing choices.
familyAccessChanged: Could not confirm membership. Records have been hidden. Review the latest state.
familyActionFailed: Could not complete this action. Check the account ID, membership and connection, then try with the latest state.
